s.x: The toilet was unusable because it was blocked.

s.g: Something that is not fit for use.

s.x: I have two unused vouchers for a free meal.
I am unused to the dark nights of the countryside.

s.g: Not usual, out of the ordinary.
s.x: Every once in a while, though, Idol comes across an unusual talent who just blows everyone away.

s.g: Something that is unusual; an anomaly.

s.x: She's unusually happy for someone who's just broken her leg.

s.g: (uncountable) The condition or state of being unusual.
Not utterable; incapable of being physically spoken or voiced; unpronounceable.
Incapable of being articulated or expressed; indescribable, inexpressible.
Not allowed to be spoken; taboo, unspeakable.
Something which is unutterable (incapable of being physically spoken, incapable of being articulated or expressed, etc.).
In an unutterable manner; inexpressibly; so bad or otherwise extreme that one cannot talk about it.
